label: secondbeach8
title_zh: Thaum 的遗产·第三部：换生灵

lines.en: : The time has come for yet another installment in our violent and glorious campaign of...glorious violence!
lines.zh: ：是时候开启我们这场暴力又辉煌的战役的又一章了——一场……辉煌的暴力！

lines.en: : Is it me or were some of us just referred to as “brothers?”
lines.zh: ：只有我这么觉得吗，刚才是不是有人被叫成「兄弟们」了？

lines.en: : If we were boys, which one of us would have the biggest wiener?
lines.zh: ：如果我们是男生，我们当中谁的鸡巴最大？

lines.en: : Blasphemy. I do not even like hot dogs.
lines.zh: ：亵渎。我甚至连热狗都不喜欢。

lines.en: : Silence! All discussion pertaining to wieners will be kept to a minimum outside of in-character sexual exploits!
lines.zh: ：肃静！除了角色扮演中的性冒险，所有关于鸡巴的讨论都给我压到最低限度！

lines.en: : We have a lot of ground to cover today and I will not allow the ramblings of the Kendo Princess and her metaphorical, sexual hot dog consume your attention in place of my...words!
lines.zh: ：今天我们有很多内容要推进，我不会允许剑道公主和她那根隐喻的、色情的热狗抢走你们的注意力，取代我的……台词！

lines.en: : The hot dog is a food item, Emerald Guardian. It is not sexual in nature.
lines.zh: ：热狗是一种食物，翡翠守护者。它本质上并不色情。

lines.en: : {i}Ahem{/i}...Whatever the case, I would like to welcome our newest campaign member to the table...
lines.zh: ：{i}咳咳{/i}……不管怎样，我想欢迎我们最新的战役成员入座……

lines.en: : Yes. It is I. Ram, the changeling bard.
lines.zh: ：是的。正是在下。Ram，换生灵吟游诗人。

lines.en: : The Emerald Guardian said the name “Ramen” was too long for a changeling. This was the compromise we reached.
lines.zh: ：翡翠守护者说「Ramen」这个名字对换生灵来说太长了。这是我们达成的折中。

lines.en: : Ramen isn’t really a...name in general, so...
lines.zh: ：Ramen 本来就不算个……正经名字，所以……

lines.en: : You know what? That doesn’t matter right now! What matters is setting the stage for the session!
lines.zh: ：你知道吗？现在那不重要！重要的是为本轮跑团搭好舞台！

lines.en: : Since Ram has not yet become an official member of the party and I’d feel bad about playing out most of the session without her, we’ll start our day off at a local tavern and maaaaaaybe introduce her there!
lines.zh: ：因为 Ram 还没有正式加入小队，而我要是没她就跑掉大半轮会觉得过意不去，所以我们今天从当地一家酒馆开始，也——许——就在那儿把她介绍进来！

lines.en: : Should I hang out in the back? The last time we went to a tavern was kind of strange for me...
lines.zh: ：我要不要待在后面？上次我们去酒馆的时候，对我来说有点奇怪……

lines.en: : Never fear, Arborea! Lidearel’s got your back!
: The smell of cheap wine and old ale assaults your senses as you push through the doors of the local tavern in Pyredale.
lines.zh: ：当你推开派尔戴尔当地酒馆的门时，廉价葡萄酒和陈年麦酒的气味扑面而来，冲击着你们的感官。

lines.en: : You know through the means of Urrheak’s divination that there exists a merchant in this town capable of providing {i}something{/i} that will aid you in your coming journey.
lines.zh: ：通过 Urrheak 的占卜，你们知道这座镇上有一个商人，能提供{i}某样东西{/i}，在你们接下来的旅程中助你们一臂之力。

lines.en: : What that is or where the merchant is located remains to be seen, but a lingering feeling in the pit of the aarakocra’s...birdlike stomach tells you you’re on the right track.
lines.zh: ：那是什么、商人在哪里，还有待观察，但那位鹰身人……鸟类般的胃里那种挥之不去的感觉告诉你们，你们走对了路。

lines.en: : But...just as the doors swing open, the merrymaking and music comes to a stop.
lines.zh: ：但……就在门被推开的瞬间，欢笑与音乐戛然而止。

lines.en: : All eyes turn to you, the band of mismatched individuals wandering into somewhere you clearly don’t belong...and you feel threatened.
lines.zh: ：所有目光都转向你们——这群格格不入的家伙，闯进了一个显然不属于你们的地方……而你们感到了威胁。

lines.en: : But before you’re able to act in response to this, a large, cloaked man stands up from the bar and raises a hand in the air.
lines.zh: ：但你们还没来得及做出反应，一个披着斗篷的高大男人就从吧台边站了起来，把手举向空中。

lines.en: : {i}Ahh. I was beginning to think you had no intention of showing up.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}：啊。我开始以为你们根本不打算出现了。{/i}

lines.en: : His voice is deep. Deep enough that the bass crawls into your stomach and churns your insides.
lines.zh: ：他的声音很低沉。低沉到那股低音会爬进你们的胃里，把五脏六腑搅动起来。

lines.en: : And even though he speaks in just one voice, you can feel as if there are many more...seemingly overlaying one another as if they’re a melody of barely intelligible, aberrant noises.
lines.zh: ：虽然他只用一种声音说话，你们却能感觉到还有更多声音……似乎一层叠着一层，像是一串几乎无法辨认的、异样的噪音组成的旋律。

lines.en: : He SLAMS his glass on the table, causing it to shatter and spill cheap ale all over the counter. But no one pays it any mind.
lines.zh: ：他把酒杯重重砸在桌上，杯子应声碎裂，廉价的麦酒洒了满吧台。但没有人在意。

lines.en: : He is done. How do you respond?
: {i}It’s bad manners to go spilling your beer on...bars and stuff.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}：把啤酒洒在……吧台什么的上面，是很没礼貌的。{/i}

lines.en: : The cloaked man does not respond. You can’t make out his face as it’s concealed by a hood, but you have a sinking feeling that he’s staring at someone.
lines.zh: ：斗篷男人没有回应。他的脸被兜帽遮住，你们看不清，但你们有一种不祥的预感——他正在盯着某个人。

lines.en: : Oh no. It’s gonna be me again. I know it.
: We never even found out why that last person freaked out on me because she went and turned into a mushroom.
lines.zh: ：我们到现在都没搞懂上一个人为什么对我发疯，因为她后来就变成蘑菇了。

lines.en: : Molly, I’m tired of fighting mushrooms. Is there some kind of roll I can do to make this...cloaked guy go away?
lines.zh: ：Molly，我打蘑菇打烦了。有没有什么骰子可以掷，好让这个……斗篷男走开？

lines.en: : I mean...you can try rolling for persuasion or intimidation or something...but I will tell you now that he is not going away.
lines.zh: ：我是说……你可以试着掷个说服或者威吓什么的……但我现在就告诉你，他是不会走的。

lines.en: : Sensing the hostility growing in the room, Lidearel reaches for her daggers...not unsheathing them, but making the cloaked guy know that she’s down to clown if he is.
lines.zh: ：察觉到房间里的敌意越来越浓，Lidearel 伸手去摸她的匕首……没有出鞘，只是让那个斗篷男知道，他要是想闹，她随时奉陪。

lines.en: : Xessaxia sees Lidearel readying for combat and reaches toward her quiver at the same time, stomping one of her hooves and wrapping her fingers around an arrow.
lines.zh: ：Xessaxia 看到 Lidearel 准备战斗，同时也把手伸向箭袋，一只蹄子重重踏地，手指扣住一支箭。
：啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！

lines.en: : Are you like...trying to communicate something with that yell? Or...
lines.zh: ：你是……想用那一嗓子传达点什么吗？还是……

lines.en: : Well, anyway...the man does not respond.
: Instead, he lifts his hand once again and snaps his fingers.
lines.zh: ：相反，他再次抬起手，打了个响指。

lines.en: : You can feel the air in the room change in an instant.
lines.zh: ：你们能感觉到房间里的空气瞬间变了。

lines.en: : But apart from the changing of the air, you can {i}also{/i} feel an increase in the amount of magic flowing into the room.
lines.zh: ：除了空气的变化，你们{i}还{/i}能感觉到涌入房间的魔力在增加。

lines.en: : Then, right before your very eyes, the glass he had shattered just moments earlier begins to reform and refill with liquid.
lines.zh: ：接着，就在你们眼前，他刚才摔碎的那只杯子开始重新成形，并重新斟满液体。

lines.en: : Nithhala takes one look at the glass as it’s filling up and decides to take a step forward.
lines.zh: ：Nithhala 看了眼正在斟满的杯子，决定向前迈一步。

lines.en: : Step forward and do what? If it’s just a step, he doesn’t react.
lines.zh: ：向前迈一步然后做什么？如果只是迈一步，他是不会有反应的。

lines.en: : I have darkvision, right? Can I use that to see inside of his hood.
lines.zh: ：我有黑暗视觉，对吧？我能用它看进他的兜帽里面吗。

lines.en: : That is not how darkvision works, Nithhala.
: Well then why the hell did I take it?
: You didn’t take it. It’s something you automatically have as a tiefling.
lines.zh: ：你没点它。那是你作为提夫林自动拥有的能力。

lines.en: : I automatically have lungs and hands and stuff too but those aren’t written on my sheet. They’ve been a hell of a lot better than darkvision, I’ll tell you that much.
lines.zh: ：肺啊手什么的我也是自动就有的，可那些没写在我的角色卡上。而且它们可比黑暗视觉有用多了，这点我敢打包票。

lines.en: : Is anyone {i}actually{/i} going to do something or do we want to use this time to complain about more of our racials?
lines.zh: ：{i}到底{/i}有没有人要做点什么？还是说我们想用这点时间继续吐槽种族特性？

lines.en: : Urrheak would like to do something.
: And what would Urrheak like to do?
: Urrheak gestures to his companions to stop reaching for their weapons and raises his...badass arm-wing things into the air.
lines.zh: ：Urrheak 示意同伴们别再摸武器，然后把他那对……超帅的翅膀手臂举向空中。

lines.en: : But he does it in a showy kind of way. Not an intimidating one.
lines.zh: ：但他摆得很花哨。不是那种有威慑力的。

lines.en: : Not really what I had in mind. But I’ll just speak to him as well.
lines.zh: ：不完全是我想要的效果。不过我还是直接跟他说吧。

lines.en: : Also, it's going to be in aarakocra and not common.
lines.zh: ：另外，我要说鹰身人语，不是通用语。

lines.en: : {i}We’re not here to fight...but we don’t know who you are either.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}：我们不是来打架的……但我们也不知道你是谁。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}If you’d be so kind as to introduce yourself to us, perhaps we can avoid bloodshed altogether and come to...some sort of understanding.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}：如果你愿意向我们做个自我介绍，也许我们可以完全避免流血，达成……某种共识。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}My friends and I are looking for something to assist in the creation of a tunnel. A tunnel to-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}：我和我的朋友们在找某样东西，用来协助开凿一条隧道。一条通往——{/i}

lines.en: : The man raises his hand in the air once more before Urrheak can finish his sentence.
lines.zh: ：Urrheak 还没说完，那个男人就再次把手举向空中。

lines.en: : Wait, if Urrheak was speaking aarakocra, how come I could understand it?
lines.zh: ：等等，如果 Urrheak 说的是鹰身人语，我怎么听得懂？

lines.en: : The man raises his hand in the air and looks into Urrheak’s eyes. And despite clearly not being a bird, he speaks in aarakocra back to him.
lines.zh: ：那个男人把手举向空中，直视 Urrheak 的眼睛。尽管他显然不是鸟，却用鹰身人语回了他。

lines.en: : {i}One snap to rewrite tiny bits and pieces of history.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}：一个响指，改写历史的细枝末节。{/i}
{i}：不过，也许你早就知道了，[young]的家伙。{/i}

lines.en: : I’m not that young. I’m canonically-
: {i}But that doesn’t mean we can’t reach some sort of understanding...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}：但这不代表我们不能达成某种共识……{/i}

lines.en: : He snaps his fingers again and disperses into thin air. But from out of the smoke emerges a lanky woman dressed as a clown.
lines.zh: ：他再次打了个响指，消散在空气中。但烟雾中走出一个瘦高的女人，穿着小丑装。

lines.en: : Clasping a lute in her hands, she begins to play you all a song...
lines.zh: ：她手里抱着一把鲁特琴，开始为你们大家弹唱一首歌……

lines.en: : Yo yo yo. My name is Ram.
: I have two legs and I like ham.
: We’re in a tavern...at a place.
lines.zh: ：我们在一家酒馆……在一个地方。

lines.en: : I have two legs. I have a face.
: She is not a very good bard.
: But you still all get a point of inspiration because, for some strange reason, you like the song a lot and now Ram is a part of your party.
lines.zh: ：但你们还是都获得了一点激励，因为出于某种奇怪的理由，你们非常喜欢这首歌，而现在 Ram 也是你们小队的一员了。

lines.en: : Lidearel isn’t going to accept that the weird cloak guy just vanished and got replaced by some girl dressed like a clown who can’t rap her way out of a paper bag.
lines.zh: ：Lidearel 可接受不了——那个奇怪的斗篷男就这么凭空消失，换成一个穿得像小丑、说唱烂得连个纸袋都钻不出来的女生。

lines.en: : And I’m allowed to say that because I finished second place in the first annual Super Mega Ultimate Dorm War.
lines.zh: ：我有资格这么说，因为我在第一届超级无敌终极宿舍大战里拿了第二名。

lines.en: : But...I agree. Xessaxia would also take issue with this.
lines.zh: ：不过……我同意。Xessaxia 也会对此有意见。

lines.en: : Of course you’re all free to ask Ram any questions you have. Tsuneyo and I spent a fair deal of time going over her backstory, so she’ll know the answers to mostly everything.
lines.zh: ：当然，你们想问 Ram 什么都可以。我和 Tsuneyo 花了不少时间敲定她的背景故事，所以基本什么问题她都知道答案。

lines.en: : Though, it’s still up to her to decide whether or not she wants to share any of that information with you.
lines.zh: ：不过，她愿不愿意把这些信息分享给你们，还是由她自己决定。

lines.en: : {i}Where do you come from? And what happened to the hot guy in the cloak?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}：你从哪里来？那个穿斗篷的帅哥怎么了？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Nithhala, you couldn’t even see his face.{/i}
: {i}I don’t know. I just woke up here.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}：我不知道。我就是在这儿醒过来的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Fine...if you want to play things that way, then get ready to-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}：好……既然你想这么玩，那就准备好——{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It’s highly probable that she really did wake up just now...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}：很有可能她真的是刚刚才醒过来的……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}We can’t factor out the possibility that she’s under some sort of spell or-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}：我们不能排除她中了某种法术的可能性，或者——{/i}

lines.en: : {i}We don’t have time for this, X...Xesa...{/i}
: Lidearel takes three points of damage.
: Don’t I get an opportunity to counter this?!
: Noriko and I were just walking down the hall when we heard you guys in here and...it sounded like you were having a lot of fun.
lines.zh: ：我和 Noriko 正好路过走廊，听到你们在这儿……听起来玩得很开心。

lines.en: : We’re playing a game! Games are fun!
: Right, Sana?! Tell her games are fun!
: Are you going to be much longer?
: I thought we could maybe hang out tonight if you’re not doing anything.
lines.zh: ：我在想，如果你们没别的事，今晚也许可以一起玩。

lines.en: : HAHAH! GAMES ARE SO FUN! RIGHT, SANA?!
: What was that, Maya? My hearing isn't that great.
lines.zh: ：你刚才说什么，Maya？我听力不太好。

lines.en: : I said move your fucking feet. That’s my futon you’re stepping all over.
lines.zh: ：我说把你他妈的脚挪开。你踩的是我的被褥。

lines.en: : Maya! She didn’t know. There’s no reason to freak out on her for it.
lines.zh: ：Maya！她又不知道。没必要为这个对她发火。

lines.en: : Perhaps I should do my second rap to lighten the mood.
lines.zh: ：也许我该来第二段说唱，缓和一下气氛。

lines.en: : My name is Ram and I’m here to say-
: You’re right. We already have a point of the inspiration.
lines.zh: ：你说得对。我们已经有一点激励了。

lines.en: : Are you actually sleeping out here?
: Of course I am. Where else would-
: You know exactly where else you’d be sleeping.
: But, sure! I’ll get off of your futon.
lines.zh: ：不过，行吧！我从你的被褥上下来。

lines.en: : I was actually just about to leave anyway.
: We can hang some other time, Otoha.
: Umm...well, now that I am apparently all alone...
lines.zh: ：嗯……好吧，既然现在我显然落单了……

lines.en: : Why are you suddenly a caveman?
: Also, please forgive me for anything extremely embarrassing I say tonight!
lines.zh: ：还有，请原谅我今晚说出的任何极其丢人的话！

lines.en: : It’ll be my first time, so I don’t really know-
lines.zh: ：这是我第一次玩，所以我不太懂——

lines.en: : Because it’s my campaign and I said no.
lines.zh: ：因为这是我的战役，我说不行。

lines.en: : We’re already in the middle of a session. We don’t have time for a new player.
lines.zh: ：我们已经在跑团中途了。没时间再带新玩家。

lines.en: : What part of that don’t you understand?
: I wasn't trying to get in the way.
: Like...I get it. It’s your game.
: Anyway, what’s going to be your party’s next move? You could either try probing Ram for more information about where she came from or follow the trail of Urrheak’s divination-
lines.zh: ：总之，你们小队下一步要怎么做？你们可以尝试向 Ram 套出更多关于她来历的信息，或者顺着 Urrheak 占卜的线索——

lines.en: : No, hold on. Why can’t Otoha play?
lines.zh: ：不，等一下。为什么 Otoha 不能玩？
：Otoha 到底喜不喜欢龙与地下城啊？

lines.en: : See? It would be too much effort just working her in right now.
lines.zh: ：看吧？现在要把她加进来太费事了。

lines.en: : Besides, we’re already a little behind schedule and-
lines.zh: ：再说，我们已经有点落后于安排了，而且——

lines.en: : You really can’t do this for me?
lines.zh: ：你就真的不能为了我做这件事吗？

lines.en: : I’m asking you as your {i}friend{/i} to do this {i}for me{/i}.
lines.zh: ：我是以你{i}朋友{/i}的身份，求你{i}为我{/i}做这件事。

lines.en: : And I can’t ask you to drop it {i}for me?{/i}
lines.zh: ：那我就不能请你{i}为了我{/i}别提了吗？

lines.en: : Rin, it’s no big deal. I'll just watch.
: I just don’t get why {i}Molly{/i} can bring in a new player and I can’t.
lines.zh: ：我就是不明白，凭什么 {i}Molly{/i} 能带新玩家进来，我就不行。

lines.en: : Especially when no one else would have a problem with it.
lines.zh: ：更何况其他人根本都不会介意。

lines.en: : I’m fine with...waiting a little longer if Otoha wants to play...
lines.zh: ：如果 Otoha 想玩的话……我可以多等一会儿……

lines.en: : We don’t have anywhere to be tomorrow...we could always stay up a little later?
lines.zh: ：我们明天又没别的地方要去……晚一点睡也没关系吧？

lines.en: : Yeah! I’ll help you make her sheet if you think that’s what going to take the longest, Molly.
lines.zh: ：对啊！如果你觉得做角色卡最花时间，我可以帮你一起做，Molly。

lines.en: : Doesn’t Molly have several extra character sheets in her binder? Otoha could just use-
lines.zh: ：Molly 的活页夹里不是有几张多余的角色卡吗？Otoha 直接用——

lines.en: : Molly, do you like...have some sort of problem with Otoha?
lines.zh: ：Molly，你是不是……对 Otoha 有什么意见？

lines.en: : Of course not. I just don’t want to sidetrack the game I spent hours and hours and hours working on to accommodate someone who’s only playing because {i}you’re{/i} here.
lines.zh: ：当然没有。我只是不想让这场我花了好几个小时、好几个小时、好几个小时准备的跑团跑偏，就为了迁就一个只是因为{i}你{/i}在才想玩的人。

lines.en: : What the hell is that supposed to mean?
: I said no and that’s final.
: Now, we were just about to leave the tavern and-
lines.zh: ：现在，我们正要离开酒馆，然后——

lines.en: : We were {i}just about{/i} to help Otoha make a fucking-
lines.zh: ：我们{i}正要{/i}帮 Otoha 做一个该死的——

lines.en: : We were not helping her do anything!
: We were going to go on a fun adventure as a party!
lines.zh: ：我们本来要以小队身份去开启一场有趣的冒险！

lines.en: : I had tons of stuff lined up for tonight that I’d have to completely rebalance if we brought on {i}another{/i} extra person!
lines.zh: ：我今晚安排了一大堆内容，如果{i}再多{/i}带一个人进来，就得全部重新平衡！

lines.en: : Why is that so hard for you to understand?!
: Emerald Guardian. I think you have popped one too many cooldowns.
lines.zh: ：翡翠守护者。我觉得你多放了一轮冷却。

lines.en: : Did I like...do something to offend you, Molly?
lines.zh: ：我是不是……做了什么冒犯你的事，Molly？

lines.en: : You don’t even know what you did!
: You just wandered in here thinking...thinking that you own the place! And that everybody likes you!
lines.zh: ：你就这么晃进来，以为……以为这里是你的地盘！以为所有人都喜欢你！

lines.en: : You’re not all that great! You’d never be able to set up a campaign like this! Create...branching paths and...innovative boss fights!
lines.zh: ：你才没那么了不起！你永远也搭不出这样的战役！创造……分支剧情还有……别出心裁的 Boss 战！

lines.en: : And...and you can’t watch either! You got that?!
lines.zh: ：还有……还有你连看都不行！听明白了吗？！

lines.en: : Balance in all things, Emerald Guardian. Remember your path.
lines.zh: ：万物皆需平衡，翡翠守护者。记住你的道。

lines.en: : You are giving into the darkness.
: For what?! Standing up for myself?! For...finally doing something for {i}me{/i}?!
lines.zh: ：凭什么道歉？！为自己站出来？！为……终于为{i}自己{/i}做了一件事？！

lines.en: : I’ve been looking forward to this {i}one thing{/i} for so long! I don’t want it to be ruined just cause...
lines.zh: ：我为{i}这一件事{/i}期待了那么久！我不想它就因为……

lines.en: : You’re not any better than me...

lines.zh: ：啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！！！！！！！！！！！！！！！！

lines.en: Free yourself from discomfort by pretending it does not exist!
lines.zh: 假装不适并不存在，以此把自己从中解放出来！

lines.en: Face your fears and brace for failure because, more times than not, things will turn out horrible!
lines.zh: 直面你的恐惧，为失败做好准备，因为大多数时候，事情都会变得很糟糕！

lines.en: And when they turn out horrible, cry!
lines.zh: 而当事情变得糟糕时，就哭吧！

lines.en: Savor the warmth of your tears as they race down your cheeks, for their existence is the only warmth you deserve!
lines.zh: 品味你泪水沿着脸颊奔流而下的温热，因为它们的存在，是你唯一配得到的温暖！

lines.en: Break yourself to build yourself back up!
lines.zh: 打碎自己，再把自己重建起来！

lines.en: Do it over and over again!
: I’m gonna go chase after her. I’ll be right back.
: Who cares? If she’s going to be a bitch to people, she should get treated like a bitch back.
lines.zh: ：谁在乎？她要是想当个婊子对人，那就该被当婊子对待。

lines.en: : Otoha did literally nothing wrong. All she did was ask to play and Molly decided to fucking explode.
lines.zh: ：Otoha 一点错都没有。她只是问了句能不能玩，Molly 就他妈炸了。

lines.en: : I have never witnessed her act in such a way before.
: Maya...did you want to chase after her as well?
: Whatever it is, I doubt there’s anything I can do about it.
lines.zh: ：不管是什么事，我怀疑我也无能为力。

lines.en: : I highly doubt it’s anything worth actually chasing after her for.
lines.zh: ：我很怀疑那有什么值得真的去追她的。

lines.en: {i}In Lessons in Love, you can trade in affection points for blowjobs.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}在《Lessons in Love》里，你可以用好感度点数兑换口交。{/i}
{i}我们去帮其中一个好受一点吧！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Click the button to make Molly feel better!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}点击按钮让 Molly 好受一点！{/i}

lines.en: When I am king, dilly, dilly
Who told you so, dilly, dilly

lines.zh: 是我自己的心，滴哩滴哩

lines.en: If you love me, dilly, dilly
